$schema_description: Copy this file to tmp/dev-frontegg.json (gitignored) and replace adminJwt with a fresh Frontegg stg-portal admin JWT. Used by tools/dev-enroll.mts so campaign creation is a genuine Frontegg-authenticated admin call (real-world onboarding parity) instead of a synthetic rubber-stamp.
$howto_adminJwt: Open https://portal.stg.frontegg.com → sign in → open DevTools → Network tab → click any authed request (e.g. a GET to /api/...) → Headers → copy the value of 'Authorization' header (strip the leading 'Bearer ' prefix). JWTs expire after ~24h.
$howto_fronteggEnvironmentId: Optional. If omitted, dev-enroll auto-extracts customClaims.accountEnvironments[environment=='development'].id from the JWT. Override when you want to enrol against a different environment (e.g. your personal dev environment).
